en: The Mahāvaipulya Sūtra Spoken by Samantabhadra, in one fascicle, translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Śikṣānanda of Khotan during the Tang Dynasty.
Thus have I heard: At one time the Buddha was staying in a place sustained by the supernatural power of the Tathāgata, together with...

He was surrounded by a retinue of bodhisattva-mahāsattvas as numerous as the atoms within ten unspeakably unspeakable hundreds of thousands of billions of nayutas of buddha-fields; for them he preached the Dharma—all of whom had already accomplished the conduct of Samantabhadra—with the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Samantabhadra as their leader.

At that time, within the great assembly, there were ten bodhisattva-mahāsattvas, each accompanied by a retinue of bodhisattvas as numerous as the atoms in hundreds of thousands of billions of nayutas of unspeakably unspeakable buddha-fields. From the various directions of the ten quarters, they suddenly appeared and all sat upon lion thrones adorned with unimpeded arrays. Their names were: Bodhisattva Universal Light Treasury, Bodhisattva Profound Depth Treasury, Bodhisattva Majestic Virtue Radiance Treasury, Bodhisattva Cloud Sound Treasury, Bodhisattva Vajra Treasury, Bodhisattva Universal Sound Immovable Majestic Radiance Treasury, Bodhisattva Universal Renown Majestic Radiance Treasury, Bodhisattva Mountain King Immovable Majestic Radiance Treasury, Bodhisattva Universal Manifestation of All Forms Majestic Radiance Treasury, and Bodhisattva Ten-Power Pure Majestic Radiance Treasury.
When those bodhisattvas appeared, within this assembly all the great multitude of bodhisattvas—except for Samantabhadra—were moved by awe, and all their majestic splendor vanished from view.

Each and every bodhisattva rained down ten unspeakably unspeakable hundreds of thousands of billions of nayutas of clouds of incense—clouds of ointment, clouds of garlands, clouds of robes, clouds of jeweled parasols, banners, and pennants, clouds of pure worlds, clouds of multi-jeweled pavilions, clouds of bodhisattva assemblies and sites of enlightenment, clouds of great nets of light shining everywhere, clouds of adornments for the site of enlightenment, and clouds of Tathāgata images and *kāṣāya* robes—each raising such inconceivable clouds of offerings that they filled the entire Dharma-realm to make offerings to the Tathāgata.
The seats upon which these bodhisattvas sit are adorned with various jewels, exquisite and pure.

Within each and every element of these adornments, there are universally manifested all infinite worlds, infinite sentient beings, infinite Buddhas, and infinite bodhisattvas. Furthermore, there are manifested unspeakably unspeakable numbers of past and future infinite worlds, as well as their respective Buddhas, seated at the site of enlightenment (*bodhimaṇḍa*). For the sake of transforming sentient beings, they turn the sublime wheel of Dharma; the assemblies of bodhisattvas make offerings to the Tathāgatas and purely cultivate all practices of the *pāramitās*, never ceasing for a moment.
At that time, the entire assembly had this thought:
"From which worlds and from the presence of which Buddhas have these bodhisattvas come?
They then together questioned Samantabhadra Bodhisattva.
At that time, Samantabhadra Bodhisattva addressed the entire assembly of bodhisattvas, saying:
"O sons of the Buddha!
Each of you should investigate the place from which you have come."

At that time, the Bodhisattva Unobstructed Eye entered the Samādhi of Universal Swiftness, the Samādhi of Universal Arrival, the Samādhi of Illuminating the Dharma Realm, the Samādhi of Possessing All Supernatural Powers, the Samādhi of Understanding All Realms, the Samādhi of Manifesting the Bodies of All Sentient Beings through Supernatural Power, and the Samādhi of Knowing All Buddha-fields. He entered ten *asaṃkhyeya* hundreds of thousands of billions of *nayuta* such bodhisattva samādhis. By the power of these samādhis, he saw his own body travel to all worlds throughout the ten directions, even reaching into the midst of every single atom; yet, he was unable to see the lands from which those bodhisattvas had come, nor the places where they had practiced the holy life under the Tathāgatas.
The rest of the entire assembly of bodhisattvas each entered their own respective bodhisattva samādhis, yet none were able to see [the coming of those bodhisattvas], and it was likewise so for all.
They all arose from their meditative absorption and addressed Samantabhadra Bodhisattva, saying:
"We each entered ten *asaṃkhyeya* hundreds of thousands of billions of *nayuta* bodhisattva samādhis, yet we were utterly unable to perceive the place from which those bodhisattvas came."
Samantabhadra Bodhisattva further addressed them, saying:
"The Buddha-lands from which they have come are profoundly deep, vast, and exceedingly difficult to perceive; you should now seek them out together once more."

Then each of those bodhisattvas further entered as many bodhisattva samādhis as there are atoms in ten buddha-fields, yet they sought him and did not see him; each reported this matter once more to Samantabhadra.

At that time, Samantabhadra Bodhisattva rose from his seat, ascended into the air, circumambulated the World-Honored One to the right countless times, and then, while remaining in mid-air, surveyed the entire assembly and spoke these words:
"O Sons of the Buddha!

Observe the Buddha’s body: its adornments are unimpeded, it is equal throughout the three periods of time, and there is no realm within the entire dharma-realm that it does not universally enter. All worlds in the ten directions, all Tathāgatas, all bodhisattvas, all sentient beings, and all realms of existence are reflected within the Tathāgata’s body; according to the inclinations of the minds of all sentient beings, he causes them all to attain awakening.

You should abide in the eye of universal scope, the pure wisdom-eye that exhausts the realm of empty space, and the vast wisdom-eye that comprehends all objects; furthermore, you should universally entreat all Buddhas of the ten directions to protect and mind you, and with a single mind, free yourselves from all places, all dependencies, all attachments, and all states of existence, and contemplate the body of the Tathāgata. You should enter the subtle realm of the Ten Powers, and within a single realm, thoroughly understand all inexhaustible realms as you contemplate the body of the Tathāgata.

At that time, all the bodhisattvas, out of reverence and obedience to his instruction, turned toward the Tathāgata, prostrated with their heads at his feet, and gazed upon him with single-minded devotion.

Suddenly they beheld the World-Honored One Vairocana; within the wheel-mark on his two feet was a world named Dharma-realm Wheel (*dharmadhātu-cakra*). In that land there was a Buddha named Dharma-realm Adornment King (*dharmadhātu-vyūha-rāja*), who remained in the world preaching the Dharma.

From that buddha-field, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Samantaprabhā-kośa, together with as many bodhisattva-mahāsattvas as there are atoms in ten unspeakably unspeakable hundreds of thousands of billions of nayutas of buddha-fields, came to this assembly and took their seats.

Within the space between the two calves, there is a world named Unobstructed Treasury (*Anāvaraṇagarbha*). In that land, there is a Buddha named Unobstructed Pure Light (*Anāvaraṇaviśuddhaprabha*) who dwells there, teaching the Dharma.

From that buddha-field, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Profound Treasury (*Gambhīrakośa*), together with as many Bodhisattva-Mahāsattvas as there are atoms in ten unspeakably unspeakable hundreds of thousands of billions of *nayutas* of buddha-fields, has come to this assembly and is seated here.

Within his two knees is a world named True Gold Treasury (*Suvarṇagarbha*). In that land dwells a Buddha named King of the Gold Treasury (*Suvarṇagarbharāja*), who remains in the world preaching the Dharma.

From that buddha-field, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vidyutprabha-garbha, together with bodhisattva mahāsattvas as numerous as the atoms in ten unspeakably unspeakable hundreds of thousands of billions of nayutas of buddha-fields, has come to this assembly and is seated.
Within his two thighs is a world named Treasury Adorned with All Jewels; in that land dwells a Buddha named Multitude of Sublime Lights who remains in the world preaching the Dharma.

From that buddha-field, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Cloud Sound Treasury, together with bodhisattva-mahāsattvas as numerous as the atoms in ten unspeakably unspeakable hundreds of thousands of billions of nayutas of buddha-fields, has come to this assembly and is seated here.
Within his navel is a world-system named Vairocanagarbha; in that land there is a Buddha named Vairocana-tejorāja-vyūha, who currently dwells there preaching the Dharma.

That Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajragarbha, together with Bodhisattva Mahāsattvas as numerous as the atoms in ten unspeakably unspeakable hundreds of thousands of billions of nayutas of buddha-fields, has come from that buddha-field to sit in this assembly.

Within his heart, there is a world named Victorious Light Treasury (*Jyotir-garbha*). In that land dwells a Buddha named Treasury of Adornments of Sublime Marks (*Lakṣaṇavyūhagarbha*), who remains in the world preaching the Dharma.

From that buddha-field, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Universal Sound Immovable Radiant Treasury (*Samantasvarācalatejagarbha*), together with bodhisattva mahāsattvas as numerous as the atoms in ten unspeakably unspeakable hundreds of thousands of billions of *nayutas* of buddha-fields, has come to this assembly and is seated here.
Between his two shoulders is a world named Golden Color; in that land there is a Buddha named King of Golden Color who dwells there, teaching the Dharma.

From that buddha-field, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Universal Renown Treasury of Majestic Radiance, together with as many Bodhisattva Mahāsattvas as there are atoms in ten unspeakably unspeakable hundreds of thousands of billions of nayutas of buddha-fields, has come to this assembly and is seated.
Within his mouth is a world named Adorned with Exquisite Jewels; in that land dwells a Buddha named King Adorned with Immeasurable Light, who remains in the world preaching the Dharma.

From that buddha-field, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Immovable Mountain-King Majestic Light-Treasury, together with bodhisattva mahāsattvas as numerous as the atoms in ten unspeakably unspeakable hundreds of thousands of billions of nayutas of buddha-fields, has come to this assembly and is seated.

In the space between his eyebrows, there is a world named Dharma-realm Inexhaustible Treasury; in that land dwells a Buddha named Inexhaustible Wisdom of the Three Times, who remains in the world preaching the Dharma.

From that buddha-field, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Universal Manifestation of All Images’ Majestic Radiance Treasury, together with bodhisattva mahāsattvas as numerous as the atoms in ten unspeakably unspeakable hundreds of thousands of billions of nayutas of buddha-fields, has come to this assembly and is seated.
Within his head is a world named Unscattered Sustenance; in that land dwells a Buddha named Jewel Flower Accumulation, who remains in the world preaching the Dharma.

From that buddha-field, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Pure Radiance Treasury of the Ten Powers, together with bodhisattva mahāsattvas as numerous as the atoms in ten unspeakably unspeakable hundreds of thousands of billions of nayutas of buddha-fields, has come to this assembly and is seated here.

At that time, having witnessed such infinite worlds, the Tathāgatas’ places of enlightenment, the assemblies of bodhisattvas, and the Buddha’s spiritual transformations, each and every one of those bodhisattvas attained ten times the number of atoms in a buddha-field of great samādhis, such as the Dharma-realm-treasury (*dharmadhātugarbha*) samādhi; ten times the number of atoms in a buddha-field of dhāraṇīs, such as the dhāraṇī of the ground of all phenomena (*sarvadharmabhūmi*); ten times the number of atoms in a buddha-field of pāramitās, such as the stainless-treasury (*vimalagarbha*) prajñāpāramitā; and ten times the number of atoms in a buddha-field of flashes of light from omniscience, such as the flash of light of power (*balavidyut*).
Then Samantabhadra Bodhisattva again addressed the great assembly:
"O Sons of the Buddha!
This Dharma can only be heard and seen by those who practice the conduct of Samantabhadra and are sustained by spiritual friends."
Therefore, you all should cultivate a vajra-like mind and a resolute intention toward this Dharma-gate, upholding and reciting it so that it is never forgotten or lost.
When this Dharma was thus spoken, those bodhisattva-mahāsattvas and others received it with joy and faith.
The Vaipulya Sūtra Spoken by Samantabhadra.
